name: Fix Persian permalinks, Arabic character contamination, and Jalali dates leaking into schema
query: سایت فارسی‌ام در گوگل خوب ایندکس نمی‌شود، اسلاگ‌ها به‌هم‌ریخته‌اند و فکر می‌کنم تاریخ شمسی در اسکیما مشکل ساخته. بررسی و درست کن.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Route to wp-persian-seo and run scripts/persian_seo_audit.mjs with --root and --url
Step 2: Confirm the SEO plugin, locale, permalink structure, and whether URLs may change
Step 3: Check <html lang="fa-IR" dir="rtl">, WPLANG, and timezone before anything else
Step 4: Decide a single slug policy (Persian or transliterated Latin) and apply it consistently
Step 5: Detect ZWNJ and Arabic ي/ك in slugs and content; back up before any bulk replace
Step 6: Verify datePublished/dateModified are Gregorian ISO 8601 with +03:30, not Jalali
Step 7: Confirm exactly one canonical and no duplicate JSON-LD blocks
Step 8: Walk references/indexing-troubleshooting.md in order for the indexing complaint
Step 9: Produce a 301 map for any slug that changes
success_criteria: No slug contains ZWNJ and no content contains Arabic ي or ك
wp search-replace is shown with --dry-run and --precise before the real run
A database backup is taken before any bulk mutation
Schema dates are Gregorian ISO 8601 with the +03:30 offset while display stays Jalali
Exactly one canonical tag and one JSON-LD block per schema type
Every changed slug has a 301 redirect and internal links point to the final URL
No ranking guarantees are promised; changes are justified by mechanism
Googlebot user-agent access is verified as 200
